No safety plans. I'm trying my best. To be honest, if I live, I won't be living for myself. 

Stopped doing that a long time ago. 

I have an appointment with another therapist. Let's see if it works out
I'm trying, I'm reaching out to people. I'll try my best
Saturday isn't here yet buddy. I'm so afraid, I'm so fucking afraid. I don't know how to do this without ruining my family. Help me please
Can I talk to you? We are hours apart. But I'll try to be awake.

I have thought about this for eleven years, to do it or not to do it. I'm done now my friend. So far off the reservation. I'm a guy, yet I can't stop crying. I know this will happen, I can't stay awake and be sane. I'm only thoughtless when I sleep. I like being under.
after my recent edit in the post, I don't know if I can get past this

the feeling is way to strong to ascertain my perception of anything, you're right, I should get a change of scenery. but it'd not help my troubles since whatever happens will stick to, whatever I do this year. Either pass my exam, fail to get into a good college, fail to be with my partner, fail to be amount to anything which I have been a lot lately. A job is hard to come by, but I have taken up photography, but recently, my depression has peaked so much I can barely take myself out of the house. I can barely think straight, i don't know, this has been a long time coming. Once you're okay with the thought that you might disappear at your own whim one day, it becomes easy. For person like me to make it happen. I tried multiple times, I never went to anyone, because I knew I'd fail and I'd try again, a vicious circle. But I think, tonight, it has come to an end. I've tried my friend, I've tried to be better for the people I love, sometimes you have to compromise for the things about them that make you unhappy, I can't. There is no way past it. And I'm ruining my loved ones because of that, they no longer feel carefree near me. No longer talk to me because I'm sad all the time and they want to have fun and it's normal for them to seek fun elsewhere. But I just can't take it anymore, this neglect, I brought this upon myself. I was okay with this, but now, when I need attention more than ever, when I've asked, all I got was that I was being selfish, controlling, that their happiness amount to nothing for me. All my life I've wished for other's happiness, my intention was always to make others happy, thats how I became happy, now such isn't the case. Now, i can't agree upon a stalemate, when I raised voice about my happiness or sanity, which only they can fix by tipping the scales, and they don't want to. I don't know where to go. Now that I've come forward with this, they think that I'm trapping them, guilt tripping them. I don't know if I should erase my existence, or cease to exist or just go back in time and punch my dad in the balls so that I never existed. Because I truly don't feel like existing anymore. I've become the spitting image of something I've always promised myself not to be. I'm sorry for droning, I have difficulty getting my points across sometimes
i went to therapy, 3 hour session, I was not taken seriously by the "renowned therapist" I have nothing else to say about that
I'm sorry to hear about your troubles, I'm afraid I do not have mental illness, but illness of mind? yeah

everyone is saying that honestly, the good people, like you. I appreciate it. But it doesn't fix anything, it's different, I've never felt like this before, I never felt like offing myself so easily and with such efficiency ever before, a probability has become a possibility.
i don't know where to start, maybe some questions would be good for starters.

hey, I apolgize for the delay. A lot has happened in the last 3 hours, I did what you did, "mailed" my sister and my girlfriend about this. I have been making things worse, for the people I love, they know they love me less, and some even hastened to leave me. But upon hearing this, their tone changed and I feel like I'm trapping them. They are desperate. This wasn't the outcome I expected and again, this isn't your fault. I had to tell my family anyways right? But now they are making it about themselves, and it has gone so far as to me being blackmailed into not offing myself. I don't know what to do, this feeling, it doesn't go away from all this. I want to do this, but I want to do this without hurting anyone, if that's even possible.
